nodes.name: eval_hybrid.py
nodes.summary: Hybrid evaluation script: tests combined DB+DOC retrieval and generation. Runs end-to-end queries through chat_service.py, measures route accuracy, SQL correctness, document relevance, answer quality, and latency. Outputs hybrid_eval_results.json.

nodes.name: breakdown.py
nodes.summary: Latency breakdown script: instruments each pipeline stage (rewrite, route, retrieve, rerank, generate SQL, execute SQL, generate answer) with per-stage timing. Outputs latency_breakdown.json with p50/p95/max per stage across N queries.

nodes.name: load_breakdown.py
nodes.summary: Load latency breakdown: runs concurrent queries (configurable workers) to measure throughput, queue depth, and resource contention. Identifies bottlenecks under load (connection pool, GPU memory, rate limits). Outputs load_test_results.json.

nodes.name: ttft.py
nodes.summary: Time-to-first-token (TTFT) measurement: instruments streaming answer generation to measure first token latency vs total completion. Tests different models (Gemma-4-31B, Flash-Lite) and prompt sizes. Outputs ttft_results.json.

nodes.name: answers_memory.json
nodes.summary: Memory test answers JSON: end-to-end conversation answers for memory evaluation dataset. Contains per-turn question, rewrite, route, answer, citations, latency, and token usage. Used for memory rewrite and answer quality analysis.

nodes.name: test_llm_router_full.py
nodes.summary: Full LLM router test: evaluates routing accuracy on 200+ questions across all routes (DB_ONLY, DOC_ONLY, HYBRID, DIRECTORY, OUT_OF_SCOPE). Measures per-route precision/recall, confusion matrix, and rewrite quality. Outputs llm_router_test_results.json.

nodes.name: test_router_accuracy.py
nodes.summary: Router accuracy test: focused on DB_ONLY vs DOC_ONLY confusion (known 40% issue). Tests keyword fallback vs LLM classification, measures false positive/negative rates per route, and evaluates prompt variations. Outputs router_accuracy_report.json.

nodes.name: drill.py
nodes.summary: Stress test drill: sustained load generator for AI pipeline. Configurable QPS, duration, query mix (DB/DOC/HYBRID). Monitors error rates, latency percentiles, quota consumption, and GPU memory. Alerts on quota exhaustion or error spikes.

nodes.name: stress.py
nodes.summary: Stress test framework: base class for stress tests with worker pool, result aggregation, metrics collection (latency, errors, tokens), and HTML report generation. Extended by drill.py, stress3.py for specific scenarios.

nodes.name: stress3.py
nodes.summary: Stress test v3: multi-scenario stress test (burst, sustained, ramp-up, soak). Tests quota rotation under concurrent load, measures key rotation fairness, and validates daily quota reset behavior. Outputs stress3_report.json.
